caption: Weekly dispatch board: visits per technician, plus unscheduled and missed work
Owner home: what needs attention today, money owed, payments this month, the week ahead
Technician app: clock in, directions, call, On my way and Start for each visit
Customer online booking on a phone, with real-time open slots
Client account with balance and invoices paid, partial or unpaid
Billing: billed, paid and outstanding, each invoice tied to its service and visit
Margin report: revenue minus material cost for every completed job
